title: The Best AI Tool In Every Category — Full Comparison
description:
Everyone's using different AI tools — here's the best one in 
every category, based on actual daily use.

For writing 👇
Grok — okay. ChatGPT — good. Claude — amazing.

For research 👇
ChatGPT — decent. Gemini — better. Perplexity — great.

For building websites and apps 👇
WordPress feels outdated. Shopify is solid. Lovable is another level.

For presentations 👇
PowerPoint is slow. Canva is decent. Gamma does it in minutes.

For coding 👇
Terminal is painful. Claude is good. Codex is next level.

For AI videos 👇
Runway is useful. Veo 3 is great. Higgsfield is on another level.

For content creation 👇
Canva is kind of good. Claude is better. Poppy AI is a hidden gem.

For AI-driven SEO 👇
Most people still guess. CYTD.ai tracks how ChatGPT, Claude 
and Google AI mention your brand — and helps fix it.
